issues.legal_issue: A conditional allotment of an industrial plot may validly require the allottee to establish the proposed industrial unit within a specified period, with failure permitting resumption of the plot.
Resumption of an industrial plot is justified where the allottee fails to make genuine progress toward establishing the proposed industrial unit despite opportunities to do so.
The allottee is entitled to a refund of the amount paid for the resumed plot with interest where the allotting corporation retained the refund funds after the allottee returned its cheque.
